fact: The butting horn-tip of the Bull, on the border it once shared with the Charioteer.
bio: Elnath (Beta Tauri) is a blue-white giant about 130 light-years away, marking the tip of the northern horn of Taurus the Bull. It sits so close to Auriga that it was historically counted as a star shared between the two constellations.
cultural: The name comes from the Arabic for 'the butting' — the point of the Bull's horn. Its position on the edge of the Milky Way made it a useful signpost between Taurus and Auriga.
